description: This Java class 'AppLabelCache' caches application labels (human-readable app names) for given package names. It uses Android's PackageManager to retrieve app labels and stores them in a local cache to avoid repeated lookups.

classes.name: AppLabelCache
classes.description: A cache for application labels, providing a method to retrieve app names given package names.

methods.name: AppLabelCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a context.

methods.name: getAppLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the application label for a given package name, using cache when possible, and falling back to querying PackageManager.
